speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Giant Cell Tumor of Bone.

The X-ray findings of a lytic lesion with a "soap bubble" appearance in a 24-year-old male, accompanied by night pain and swelling, are highly characteristic of this benign but locally aggressive malignancy. Are there any constitutional symptoms such as fever, weight loss, or night sweats?
